checks: Any full feasible denominator restricts to an admissible face denominator. An affine extension on the full relative span plus a positive multiple of a base exposing functional preserves normalization at Y and drives every off-face contribution to zero uniformly.
A proper face has at least one positive-volume omitted fiber, so a finite full feasible denominator always has objective strictly above the face infimum.

The relative ball bounds all feasible parameters, including the case of a one-base face with continuous dimension d. Strict positivity on the compact hull is an open condition. An affine limiting zero must occur on an actual fiber because S_F is compact and generates the hull.

An identically zero restriction gives infinite integral. Otherwise a cone to an interior positive-level disk gives the s^(d−1) section factor and divergent integral against s^(-d−1), also for d=1 using a counting-measure point. Fatou implies boundary blowup and compact sublevels.

The mixed Hessian vanishes in a direction only if its affine form vanishes everywhere on every positive full-dimensional fiber, hence on their hull. Differentiation and stationarity give both escort identities and positivity.
Checked baefc769abdb40f1 opening and (1), and fixed-fiber cone proof in 5a3c8a5af6aaf266 §3. The latter source has a broader variable-body statement which is not needed here.

overlap.comparison: Gives ordinary one-body minimization and identical escort equations when the face has one occupied fiber. It does not address an arbitrary finite union of positive fibers or the restriction to a proper minimal base face.
Gives the same face operation for denominators depending only on finite bases. The new face objective also varies over continuous coefficients and requires blowup at a continuous supporting trace.

readability: The displayed parameter domain is the relative span of the relevant hull; minimizers on a proper face are limits in the full problem.
review_method: Independent cold mathematical proof review with exact symbolic and rational replays where applicable.
summary: The mixed objective restricts exactly to the minimal base face. Interior relative marks give a unique positive minimizer and the two escort identities by coercivity and strict convexity.
